title: HYBE Adds Buenos Aires and São Paulo Live Broadcasts to HYBE CINE FEST 2026 — BTS's First Argentina Performance
detail: September 22-23, 2026 — HYBE and Trafalgar Releasing announced that HYBE CINE FEST 2026 expands to more than 60 territories, running in cinemas worldwide October 24-31. The lineup's headline additions are two live cinema broadcasts of the BTS WORLD TOUR 'ARIRANG' from its South American leg: a Buenos Aires show broadcast live October 24 in the Americas (October 25 elsewhere) — billed as BTS's first-ever live viewing broadcast from South America and the group's first-ever performance in Argentina — followed by a São Paulo broadcast on October 30 (Americas) / October 31 (elsewhere). The six-presentation festival also includes concert films from SEVENTEEN, TOMORROW X TOGETHER and ENHYPEN, plus a 3D 'HYBE Cheering Party' experience. International tickets go on sale September 30 at 6am PT / 9am ET / 2pm BST via hybecinefest.com.

media.caption: HYBE CINE FEST 2026 expands globally, adding live BTS 'ARIRANG' broadcasts from Buenos Aires and São Paulo.
